summary: Added Graph.cbd(resource) to rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) implementing the W3C CBD rules: subject triples, recursive blank-node expansion with the cycle guard, and reification via rdf:subject reifiers. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with class CbdTestCase covering the required counts, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node-in-reification non-expansion, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Tests were not run, per instructions; counts were verified by hand against the fixture. Nothing committed.
